facts: Tenant occupied two-bed terrace from 2022-09-01 to 2024-01-15; landlord retained the full 2400 GBP deposit citing combined damages and end-of-tenancy cleaning. Tribunal found a partial deduction was reasonable but did not apportion the award to specific items.

ground_truth_outcome.unapportioned_reason: Tribunal found a partial deduction was reasonable but did not apportion the award to specific issues; reasoning at para 22 declines to break the figure down.

key_reasoning_quotes.text: It is unnecessary on the present facts to apportion the award between the items claimed.
